d:
History in the making in Michigan. Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has declared victory over Republican Mike Rogers in the US Senate race, potentially becoming the first Muslim ever elected to the US Senate.
The 42-year-old doctor campaigned on promises of universal healthcare and making medical treatment more affordable. His victory would also help Democrats retain a crucial Senate seat currently held by retiring Senator Gary Peters.
"Michigan, we did it!" El-Sayed told supporters in Detroit as he declared himself senator-elect.
